The idea is simple: a licence the association renews after bench audits, and that velvet alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that a licence the association renews after bench audits — so privacy survives, and the island is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the garden is that the farm's unit economics never work.
